Individual professional experience Raju Lalwani’s individual professional experience outside SetuHashi.

Recruiting adult students in Japan and training colleagues

Explaining value to Japanese customers, in Japanese.

The objective

Attract new adult students to English-language programmes run by a Japanese education company. The hardest part was conveying why English mattered for Japan’s place in a more globalized world.

Raju’s contribution

Working in Japanese, Raju explained the programmes to prospective adult students and signed up several new students, including people from different backgrounds. He was later promoted to shunin (主任), a position in which he trained three colleagues.

The outcome

Several new adult students enrolled through his work, and three colleagues were trained under him. No enrolment figures are reported.

Source: Raju Lalwani’s account.

The experience this brings

Presenting an offer convincingly to Japanese customers and colleagues, and helping others meet the standards a Japanese organization expects.

Related services

  • Reach customers in Japan
  • Prepare teams to work together

Linked as transferable experience, not as a Japan–India assignment.
